# AI risk management procedure and register

Maintained by the risk owner at Example Ltd and reviewed each quarter.

<!-- clause: 6.2 -->
## 6.2 Communication and consultation
Stakeholders consulted and how the exchange is recorded: customers, the model risk team and the data protection officer are consulted at each review; minutes are kept in the risk folder.

<!-- clause: 6.3.2 -->
## 6.3.2 Defining the scope
The scope covers (in scope and out of scope): the credit scoring service and its training pipeline are in scope; marketing analytics is out of scope.

<!-- clause: 6.3.3 -->
## 6.3.3 External and internal context
External and internal context factors: lending regulation, customer expectations, a small data science team and a shared cloud platform.

<!-- clause: 6.3.4 -->
## 6.3.4 Defining risk criteria
Risk criteria, scale and the level that needs approval: likelihood and impact are scored 1 to 5; any level of 15 or more needs sign-off by the head of risk.

<!-- clause: 6.4.2 -->
## 6.4.2 Risk identification
Sources and consequences are identified and listed in the register below: biased scoring, data drift and model misuse are identified and listed in the register below.

<!-- clause: 6.4.3 -->
## 6.4.3 Risk analysis
Analysis of likelihood and level for each register row: each register row is scored for likelihood and impact using the last twelve months of incident data.

<!-- clause: 6.4.4 -->
## 6.4.4 Risk evaluation
Evaluation compares each level with the criteria and sets treatment priority: levels of 15 or more are treated first; the others follow the quarterly plan.

| Risk | Cause | Likelihood | Impact | Level | Treatment | Owner | Review date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Biased scoring | Skewed training data | 3 | 4 | 12 | Fairness review | Risk owner | 2026-12-01 |

<!-- clause: 6.5.2 -->
## 6.5.2 Selection of risk treatment options
Option chosen (avoid, reduce, share or accept) and the reason: reduce for bias and drift, avoid for unsupervised overrides; chosen on cost and residual level.

<!-- clause: 6.5.3 -->
## 6.5.3 Preparing and implementing risk treatment plans
Treatment plan, owner, deadline and residual risk: each risk has a named owner, a deadline within the quarter and a recorded residual level.

<!-- clause: 6.6 -->
## 6.6 Monitoring and review
Review schedule and how findings feed back: quarterly review by the risk owner; findings feed the next register version.

<!-- clause: 6.7 -->
## 6.7 Recording and reporting
Where outcomes are documented and reported to management: outcomes are stored in this file and summarised for the management board each quarter.
